message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charges based on facts. The case involves illegal processing of hazardous waste (waste oil) without permit, causing environmental pollution, illegal disposal of hazardous waste, and possibly illegal business of dangerous waste. Also profit from illegal activity. Likely charges: illegal dumping of hazardous waste, illegal discharge of hazardous waste, illegal processing of hazardous waste, environmental pollution crime (environmental pollution causing damage). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "非法排放危险废物罪" (illegal discharge of hazardous waste) and "非法处置危险废物罪" (illegal disposal). Also "非法经营危险废物" maybe. Also "非法采矿"? Not. Also "非法经营危险废物" requires license. They processed waste oil into fuel without license, and illegally disposed waste water and waste residue. So charges: "非法排放危险废物罪" and "非法处置危险废物罪". Also possibly "非法经营危险废物罪". The facts: they did not have dangerous waste operating permit, they processed waste oil, sold fuel oil, and illegally disposed waste water and waste residue, causing environmental damage. So the appropriate charge is "非法排放危险废物罪" (illegal discharge of hazardous waste) and "非法处置危险废物罪" (illegal disposal of hazardous waste). Also maybe "非法经营危险废物罪" (illegal operation of hazardous waste). Chinese law: Article 338 of Criminal Law: illegal dumping of hazardous waste, illegal discharge, illegal disposal, illegal transport, etc. The crime of illegal discharge of hazardous waste (非法排放危险废物罪) includes illegal discharge into environment without permit. Illegal disposal (非法处置危险废物罪) includes illegal storage, transport, disposal. They also processed waste oil into fuel, which is illegal processing of hazardous waste (maybe "非法利用危险废物"?). But typical charges: "非法排放危险废物罪" and "非法处置危险废物罪". Also "非法经营危险废物罪" if they engaged in business. The facts: they sold fuel oil derived from waste oil, but the main illegal act is processing hazardous waste without permit, and illegal discharge and disposal. So answer likely: [罪名]非法排放危险废物罪;非法处置危险废物罪<eoa>
